config.label: NVD API key
config.description: NVD API key. Without it, rate limit is 5 req/30s; with it, 50 req/30s. Get one free at nvd.nist.gov/developers/request-an-api-key.

config.label: Per-request timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Raise to 60000 when using nvd_get_cve_history without an API key.
